In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], several members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] set up an ambush on an '''uninhabited planetoid'''. They sent out a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] that was picked up by four [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] on a far reconnaissance patrol, and when the [[TIE series/Legends|TIEs]] arrived, they were promptly destroyed, and their [[Milnn|lone survivor]] was interrogated. [[Flying Bantha Squadron|Four Rebels]] then used his recognition codes to enter his [[secret armada]], which was passing near the [[Planet/Legends|planetoid]], in stolen TIEs of their own.
